title: Score-Only Distillation for Compact Dense Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2607.11465v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large embedding models improve retrieval quality, but serving large encoders online is expensive. We study whether a compact retriever can learn teacher ranking behavior from score vectors without access to teacher hidden states. The student trains on rows built from ground-truth positives and negative candidates produced by our data generation pipeline; we evaluate student-teacher hard-negative mining separately as an extension. We use a row-centered score-vector objective, a memory-efficient implementation of uniform all-pairs PairMSE loss. On a fixed eight-task evaluation panel, our distillation protocol recovers up to 50% of the base-to-teacher gap. The distilled 0.6B student is 4.7 times faster for query encoding and 9.7 times faster for document encoding than sequential online teacher fusion. External-transfer performance after distillation remains mixed, so our evidence supports compression of teacher rankings under matched re

translated_title: 仅基于分数的紧凑型稠密检索蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.11465v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大型嵌入模型提升了检索质量，但在线服务大型编码器成本高昂。我们研究紧凑型检索器是否能够仅从分数向量学习教师的排名行为，而无需访问教师的隐藏状态。学生模型在由真实正例和我们的数据生成流程产生的负候选构建的行上进行训练；我们将学生-教师硬负样本挖掘作为扩展单独评估。我们采用行中心分数向量目标，这是统一全对PairMSE损失的内存高效实现。在固定的八任务评估面板上，我们的蒸馏协议恢复了基础模型到教师差距的50%。蒸馏后的0.6B学生模型在查询编码上速度快4.7倍，在文档编码上比顺序在线教师融合快9.7倍。蒸馏后的外部迁移性能仍然参差不齐，因此我们的证据支持在匹配重排场景下压缩教师排名。
tldr: 本文提出仅利用分数向量进行蒸馏的方法，使紧凑检索器恢复教师排名差距的50%，同时实现4.7倍查询编码和9.7倍文档编码的速度提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes score-only distillation for compact retrievers, recovering 50% of the teacher gap while achieving 4.7x faster query encoding and 9.7x faster document encoding.
